verdict.rationale: Exa's docs and specialized excerpt-extraction model imply neural/semantic retrieval, and a community poster confirms the core insight that keyword-based SERP doesn't work well for LLM retrieval, validating the semantic-search premise. However, other hands-on reports show noticeable misses/slow performance and low accuracy on some queries, so quality is inconsistent rather than clearly superior to keyword search in practice. Missing for 10: explicit benchmark or documented comparison showing Exa finds results keyword search misses, and more consistent positive hands-on validation of retrieval accuracy.
